arxiv-2012-03304.description: Abstract . The symmetrized bidisc G = def { ( z + w , z w ) : | z | < 1 , | w | < 1 } , G\stackrel{{\scriptstyle\rm{def}}}{{=}}\{(z+w,zw):|z|<1,\ |w|<1\}, under the Carathéodory metric, is a complex Finsler space of cohomogeneity 1 1 in which the geodesics, both real and complex, enjoy a rich geometry.

arxiv-2402-11498.title: Verifiably Following Complex Robot Instructions with Foundation Models
arxiv-2402-11498.creator: Benedict Quartey, Eric Rosen, Stefanie Tellex, George Konidaris, Department of Computer Science, Brown University
arxiv-2402-11498.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Benedict Quartey, Eric Rosen, Stefanie Tellex, George Konidaris, Department of Computer Science, Brown University. When instructing robots, users want to flexibly express constraints, refer to arbitrary landmarks, and verify robot behavior, while robots must disambiguate instructions into specifications and ground instruction referents in the real world. To address this problem, we propose Language Instruction grounding for Motion Planning (LIMP), an approach that enables robots to verifiably follow complex, open-ended instructions in real-world environments without prebuilt semantic maps.

arxiv-2405-16225.title: Local Causal Structure Learning in the Presence of Latent Variables
arxiv-2405-16225.creator: Feng Xie, Zheng Li, Peng Wu, Yan Zeng, Chunchen Liu, Zhi Geng
arxiv-2405-16225.description: Abstract Discovering causal relationships from observational data, particularly in the presence of latent variables, poses a challenging problem. While current local structure learning methods have proven effective and efficient when the focus lies solely on the local relationships of a target variable, they operate under the assumption of causal sufficiency.

arxiv-2406-00171.title: Polarization-Resolved Transmission Matrices of Specialty Optical Fibers
arxiv-2406-00171.creator: Erin S. Lamb, Tristan Kremp, David J. DiGiovanni, Paul S. Westbrook
arxiv-2406-00171.description: Abstract Transmission matrix measurements of multimode fibers are now routinely performed in numerous labs, enabling control of the electric field at the distal end of the fiber and paving the way for the potential application to ultrathin medical endoscopes with high resolution.

arxiv-2406-08045.title: A novel approach to graph distinction through GENEOs and permutants
arxiv-2406-08045.creator: Giovanni Bocchi, Massimo Ferri, Patrizio Frosini
arxiv-2406-08045.description: Abstract The theory of Group Equivariant Non-Expansive Operators (GENEOs) was initially developed in Topological Data Analysis for the geometric approximation of data observers, including their invariances and symmetries. This paper departs from that line of research and explores the use of GENEOs for distinguishing r r -regular graphs up to isomorphisms.

arxiv-2410-11107.title: Recursively Feasible Stochastic Model Predictive Control for Time-Varying Linear Systems Subject to Unbounded Disturbances footnoteinfo
arxiv-2410-11107.creator: Jacob W. Knaup correspondingAuthor, Panagiotis Tsiotras
arxiv-2410-11107.description: Abstract Model predictive control solves a constrained optimization problem online in order to compute an implicit closed-loop control policy. Recursive feasibility—guaranteeing that the optimal control problem will have a solution at every time step—is an important property to guarantee the success of any model predictive control approach.

arxiv-2410-16793.title: Controllability and kinetic limit of spherical particles immersed in a viscous fluid
arxiv-2410-16793.description: Abstract . This paper deals with systems of spherical particles immersed in a viscous fluid. Two aspects are studied, namely the controllability of such systems, with particular attention to the case of one active particle and either one or two passive ones, and the kinetic limit of such systems as the number of particles diverges.

arxiv-2505-14554.title: A Renormalizable Model of Quantized Gravitational and Matter Fields
arxiv-2505-14554.creator: D. G. C. McKeon, F. T. Brandt, J. Frenkel, S. Martins-Filho
arxiv-2505-14554.description: Abstract A Lagrange multiplier field can be used to restrict radiative corrections to the Einstein-Hilbert action to one-loop order. This result is employed to show that it is possible to couple a scalar field to the metric (graviton) field in such a way that the model is both renormalizable and unitary.

arxiv-2511-23094.creator: Jens-Peter Kreiss, Panagiotis Maouris and Efstathios Paparoditis
arxiv-2511-23094.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jens-Peter Kreiss, Panagiotis Maouris and Efstathios Paparoditis. pmc-11445588.title: EFFICACY OF A NEW VIDEO OBSERVATIONAL TRAINING METHOD (INTENSIVE VISUAL SIMULATION) FOR MOTOR RECOVERY IN THE UPPER LIMB IN SUBACUTE STROKE: A FEASIBILITY AND PROOF-OF-CONCEPT STUDY
pmc-11445588.creator: Etienne OJARDIAS, Ahmed ADHAM, Hugo BESSAGUET, Virginie PHANER, Diana RIMAUD, Pascal GIRAUX
pmc-11445588.description: ObjectiveTo demonstrate the feasibility and efficacy of a new video-observation training method (intensive visual simulation) to improve upper limb function.DesignSmall sample, randomized, evaluator-blind, monocentric study.PatientsSeventeen early subacute ischaemic stroke patients with complete hemiplegia were randomly assigned to the therapeutic group (n = 8) or control group (CG, n = 9).

pmc-11643504.title: A Comparative Study of Precision Surface Grinding Using Additively Fabricated Acrylonitrile–Butadiene–Styrene (ABS) Wheels with Continuous and Serrated Working Surfaces
pmc-11643504.creator: Dawid Zieliński, Mariusz Deja, Mateusz Zator
pmc-11643504.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Nowadays, high requirements imposed by mechanical components make it necessary to develop modern production methods. Additive technologies have been dynamically developing in recent years, showing many advantages associated with the fabrication of elements with complex geometries and structures. One of the areas where the potential of additive technologies is exploited is the rapid tooling sector, which is based on the rapid production of tools and components used in various manufacturing methods.

pmc-11649379.title: Transcatheter aortic valve implantation in patient with combined aortic and subaortic membrane stenosis: a case report
pmc-11649379.creator: Hesham Tayel, Abdelrahman Elhakim, Mohamed Elsoudi, Amira Nour, Mohammed Saad
pmc-11649379.description: BackgroundThe combination of symptomatic aortic stenosis (AS) and subaortic membrane (SAM) is rare, and the haemodynamic consequences of this combination are challenging to diagnose and manage.Case summaryWe present the case of a 78-year-old male who presented with symptomatic AS and chronic heart failure. On echocardiography, the combination of AS and SAM was diagnosed.

pmc-11757890.title: Transdermal electrophysiological recordings of diet-induced small fiber peripheral neuropathy using a needle electrode array in mice and man
pmc-11757890.creator: Magdalena Blaszkiewicz, Lydia Caron, Brooke Villinski, Joshua Passarelli, Julia M. Towne, Naeemah M. Story, Erin Merchant, Furrukh S. Khan, Nuri Emanetoglu, Leonard Kass, Rosemary L. Smith, Kristy L. Townsend
pmc-11757890.description: BackgroundDiabetic peripheral neuropathy (DPN) is a common complication of diabetes. Proactive treatment options remain limited, which is exacerbated by a lack of sensitive and convenient diagnostics, especially early in disease progression or specifically to assess small fiber neuropathy (SFN), the loss of distal small diameter axons that innervate tissues and organs.

The solid-state reaction method was used to synthesize samples.

pmc-12614297.title: A cross-sectional study of macronutrients, vitamins, minerals, and bioactive components in human milk of approved milk bank donors from low-, middle-, and high-income countries
pmc-12614297.creator: Maryanne T Perrin, Kimberly Mansen, Kiersten Israel-Ballard, Lars Bode, Daniela Hampel, Setareh Shahab-Ferdows, Lindsay H Allen, Francisca Cofré Maggio, Emily M Njuguna, Hoang Thi Tran, Aleksandra Wesolowska
pmc-12614297.description: BackgroundCurrently, clinical care of preterm infants is limited by a dearth of information on the nutritional and bioactive composition of donor human milk (DHM).ObjectivesThe primary objective is to assess and compare the macronutrients, vitamins, minerals, human milk oligosaccharides (HMOs), and antimicrobial proteins in human milk from approved milk banks in a variety of low-, middle-, and high-income settings.

pmc-12650518.title: Pancreatic Metastases from Cervical Squamous Cell Carcinoma: Systematic Review of the Literature and Case Report
pmc-12650518.creator: Siyuan Qian-Zhang, Diego Romero-Triana, Cecilia Meliga, Víctor Domínguez-Prieto, Begoña López-Botet Zulueta, Mario Martín-Sánchez, Santos Jiménez-Galanes, Enrique Rojo-Villardón, Pedro Villarejo-Campos, Maher Y Abdalla
pmc-12650518.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Pancreatic metastases from cervical cancer are exceptionally rare, with limited cases described in the literature. Their diagnosis and management remain challenging due to the absence of standardized protocols and the often poor prognosis. Case Presentation: We report the case of a 39-year-old woman with a history of treated stage IIIB cervical squamous cell carcinoma who presented with a solitary mass in the pancreatic tail. Diagnosis was established through cross-sectional imaging, PET-CT, and EUS-guided needle biopsy.

pmc-12653209.title: Biological Characteristics of Dasineura jujubifolia and Its Parasitoid Natural Enemies in Hami Region of Xinjiang (China)
pmc-12653209.creator: Kailiang Li, Zhiqiang Ge, Zhenyu Zhang, Yuhao Nie, Hongying Hu, Alessandra Marieli Vacari
pmc-12653209.description: Simple SummaryThe jujube gall midge Dasineura jujubifolia induces leaf galls that weaken trees and reduce yield in Xinjiang’s arid jujube orchards, highlighting an urgent need for region-specific, evidence-based management. We carried out a season-long, standardized field survey in two orchards in Hami (Xinjiang, China), combined with gall dissection and laboratory rearing, to document the midge’s biology and associated natural enemies.

pmc-13240077.title: A Prescriptive Model for Protecting Nurses' Dignity and Safety: Understanding Coping Processes in the Face of Workplace Violence
pmc-13240077.creator: Zahra Ebrahimi Rigi, Parvin Mangolian Shahrbabaki, Fazlollah Ahmadi, Ali Ravari
pmc-13240077.description: AimsThis study aims to design a prescriptive model for protecting nurses' dignity and safety by systematically exploring their coping processes in response to workplace violence and examining how these empirically derived processes can inform the development of a conceptually grounded prescriptive framework.DesignA qualitative, two‐phase design was used.

pmc-13425834.title: Risk-Stratified Association of Lipoprotein(a) With Carotid Plaque Burden in Middle-Aged Adults
pmc-13425834.creator: Anastasios Kollias, Dimitra Krystallaki, Aikaterini Komnianou, Thomas Tsaganos, Emelina Stambolliu, Eirini-Chrysovalanti Antonogiannaki, Konstantinos G Kyriakoulis, George S Stergiou
pmc-13425834.description: Graphical AbstractKey words: carotid atherosclerosis, cardiovascular risk, lipoprotein(a), primary prevention What is the clinical question being addressed? Does lipoprotein(a) relate to the presence and burden of subclinical carotid atherosclerosis? What is the main finding? Lipoprotein(a) was not associated with plaque presence, but was associated with greater plaque burden, particularly at very-high atherosclerotic cardiovascular risk.

pmc-13465184.title: The Spanish transplantation model as a benchmark: clinical, societal, and economic impact of liver transplants in Spain (1984–2024)
pmc-13465184.creator: Edson Plasencia Sánchez, Concepción Gómez Gavara, Glòria Merino Pinto, Roger Sabater Mezquita, Itxarone Bilbao, Gerardo Blanco-Fernández, Gloria de la Rosa, Gemma Piella
pmc-13465184.description: Spain leads the world in organ donation, and the 40th anniversary of its first liver transplant was recently commemorated. Our aim was to evaluate the evolution of the Liver Transplantation (LT) program in Spain over its four decades (1984–2024), examining clinical outcomes and societal economic benefits within a mature transplantation framework.
